visualReview.scope: Detailed published exterior and open bowl.
visualReview.notes: All twelve portable and twelve shared frames inspected, with full-resolution GFRC light slots, western hospitality and placement. The corrected hospitality glazing faces the bowl and clears the seats. Individual panel joints and true light openings, inclined feet, triangular ring truss, undulating roof, three orange tiers and podium stairs form coherent visible geometry.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared concrete, painted steel and membrane use physical UV scales. Earth-tone concrete tints and local roof glazing are preserved. Geographic rendering with sky-PMREM and unloading checks passed.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped stadium, separate roof loops and pitch polygon establish the anchor and nearly north-south axis; western hospitality removes facade ambiguity. North-up frame follows the mapped calabash belly. Native Y0 is the local field and structural foot datum, with the finite-width inclined footing cross-sections embedded 0.232m below it.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: The roof designer, fabrication analyst and GFRC supplier establish the distinct calabash profile, eight panel colors, short light slots, 120 facade sectors, sixty roof cantilevers and three-chord ring supported at twenty-eight locations. Original geometry was compared with five engineer photographs. The designer’s 40m roof datum governs over the conflicting supplier summary. Panel mosaic, individual seat distribution, connection phases and minor podium levels are reconstructed; transient event graphics and enclosed hospitality interiors are outside the exterior scope.
